STATUS: CONFLICT
For SNPs, the vendor default hard filters are QD < 2.0 and FS > 60.0 [CF-QD:default] [CF-FS:default]. A local SOP / clinic protocol uses QD < 1.5 and FS > 45.0 as alternatives, not vendor defaults [CF-QD:local] [CF-FS:local]. The decision on which to use is pending (V3). For a small panel, hard filtering is the suggested method because VQSR needs many variants [int_cq_scope#h004]. A variant at an exon end with only a low FS flag should be reviewed with SOR rather than discarded [int_cq_scope#h004].
